text:
zoe_support: Heads-up — getting repeated 502/504s from hosted inference for tenant acme-inc, started ~11:45 UTC. CS flagged a P1 customer escalation.
marc_oncall: Noted. Any pattern? specific endpoint or model?
zoe_support: Mostly /v1/generate endpoints, spikes align with tenant burst traffic. Gateway logs show upstream read timeouts and a lot of 504s.
zoe_support: paste of gateway tail: 
```
Ingress-gw | 2024-11-05T11:46:02Z | upstream read timeout from 10.42.7.23: 504
Model-pool | 2024-11-05T11:46:03Z | readiness probe failed: timeout after 10s
```
lee_runtime: Looks like scale-up lag + readinessProbe timeouts. KEDA/HPA logs? Could be scaler cooldown/pollingInterval too slow so pods aren’t spiking fast enough.
marc_oncall: Can someone run: `kubectl get hpa -n hosted-acme`, `kubectl get scaledobject -n hosted-acme -o yaml acme-generator` and `kubectl describe pods -n hosted-acme | grep -i readiness`
ana_product: (cc @jamal_cs) customers are seeing timeouts and some are retrying aggressively, increasing queue pressure. We're getting two support tickets and a customer call in 20m.
jamal_cs: I messaged the account team, they want ETA for fix. If this is scale-up, customers may want a short-term capacity reservation.
marc_oncall: Quick checks show ScaledObject annotation has `cooldownPeriod: 300` and `pollingInterval: 60` for the KEDA trigger — too conservative for bursts. HPA target metrics show slow ramp.
lee_runtime: Confirmed. Also readinessProbe is 5s initial but container start sometimes >20s due to model init/kv cache warmup. That makes pods NotReady and gateway waits -> 504.
zoe_support: Repro steps for ops: 1) hit /v1/generate with concurrency 40 for tenant id 12345 2) watch HPA/ScaledObject metrics 3) observe pods stuck in Init/NotReady for 15-30s.
marc_oncall: Short-term mitigation: patch ScaledObject annotations to `pollingInterval: 5` and `cooldownPeriod: 30`, and increase minReplicas for that tenant to 2. Also temporarily raise readinessProbe timeout to 40s for model-pool. I'll prepare a patch.
lee_runtime: Longer term: add a prewarm annotation or small warm-pool per tenant and increase model init parallelism. Also consider KV cache persistence to speed first-token. File a follow-up in eng-runtime.
deploy-bot: Started patch rollout: `kubectl patch scaledobject acme-generator -n hosted-acme --patch '{"metadata": {"annotations": {"keda.sh/pollingInterval": "5", "keda.sh/cooldownPeriod": "30"}}}'` — 3/3 replicas updated.
deploy-bot: Patched deployment: readinessProbe timeout -> 40s for dc/model-pool-acme, rolling restart initiated.
marc_oncall: Monitoring metrics now. Error rate dropped from ~18% -> 2% over last 3 mins. Latency for first token improved for new pods.
jamal_cs: Passed update to customer, they acknowledged and paused escalation. They asked for postmortem and cause.
ana_product: Assigning follow-up: eng-runtime to own prewarm and init perf (ana_product -> create ticket). CS wants SLA remediation options (jamal_cs owner).
billing-bot: Note: increasing minReplicas will impact committed-reserved metrics for tenant; FYI finance may want a note.
marc_oncall: Action items: (1) eng-runtime: prewarm plan + model init perf (2) infra: evaluate default KEDA polling/cooldown for bursty tenants (3) ops: consider tenant-specific emergency minReplicas knob.
zoe_support: Thanks — closing this slack thread once postmortem doc exists. Will paste incident timeline and commands used into the ticket. :thumbsup:
